jobs.title: Head of Digital Transformation CDMO Pharma (f/m/d)
jobs.notes: Reports to the CEO of a 4,000-employee contract manufacturer for pharma. Owns the digital strategy across data, AI, platforms and operating models, including process digitization, KPI-based value tracking and global standardization across 15 sites. Posted about 23 hours before the check, 53 clicked apply. Verified live 2026-11-03. Gaps: the profile is AI and big data heavy (data lakes, ML at scale, cloud platforms), the posting says it targets leaders from top tech companies or consulting firms, on-site in Starnberg, pharma instead of aviation, salary not stated (120k+ inferred from CEO-report level).

jobs.title: Head of Digital Factory
jobs.notes: Builds an in-house digital factory for the portfolio companies of a private equity investor: use cases, MVPs and roll-outs, process automation with LLMs, low-code and RPA, cross-functional teams. Verified live 2026-11-03 (50 clicked apply). Gaps: wants a tech lead and product or platform owner background, regular travel to portfolio companies, investor with an operational consulting flavour, team size and salary not stated.

Gaps: automotive and battery electronics program delivery (V-cycle, ASPICE) rather than process management, wants 8+ years in automotive, battery or power electronics, salary not stated.
